title: Message files
lead: One flat or nested JSON object per namespace, one file per locale. Keys are namespace:dot.path; nested objects flatten into dot paths.
params_text: \{$name\} interpolates a value passed as the second argument to t.
plurals_text: MF2's .match picks a branch from the value — plural categories, not just one/other, and they come from the locale's own rules, not from the library.
numbers_text: Formatting is Intl under an MF2 spelling: the same message renders €1,234.50 in English and 1.234,50 € in German with nothing locale-specific in your code. Available in every message: :number, :integer, :offset, :string (required), plus :currency, :date, :datetime, :time, :percent, :unit (draft).
errors_text: Nothing throws. A source that doesn't compile renders as its own key; a missing parameter leaves MF2's fallback text. A key missing from the active locale walks a chain: same-language siblings, then defaultLocale, then the key itself.
